requested_deliverable: Clean conceptual long-horizon video in the existing complete laboratory
scenario: Representative calibrated, optically characterized white/black tracked-stagnation workflow
robot: Existing Unitree G1 + Inspire FTP, one identity throughout
initial_conditions: Machined/coated components and two constructed apparatus assemblies are already available; fabrication and curing are outside this concept sequence.
Calibration plumbing, supplied calibration conditions, optical references and compatible sample holders are prepared.
The existing utility cart is staged in the southern aisle with the identified DAQ and two disabled source meters.
White and black apparatus are staged at their respective assembly benches; their identities remain unchanged through cart and outdoor transfers.

source_logic: Optical reference/sample loading precedes closed-cover acquisition.
White and black assemblies remain separate identified objects.
Transport and outdoor placement precede the covered-aperture baseline.
The aluminum aperture lids are removed after the covered baseline; both PE layers stay installed.
The reflector is adjusted and the operator withdraws from the optical area.
Acquisition is stopped before disconnecting and collecting the assemblies.
presentation_inferences: All motion, hand poses, camera motion and action durations are authored kinematic choreography.
Precision fastening, paste setting, individual wire termination and all eight sensor repetitions are condensed gestures.
The source five-minute covered baseline is represented by a shorter presentation wait; no measured temperature or cooling-power result is fabricated.
A 50 mm optical witness and removable aluminum aperture covers are simple presentation geometry tied to the existing operation definitions.
Ordinary extension lead routing and cart staging are authored scene arrangements.
This selected route does not show PID-power sweeps, alternative LDPE/band configurations or the three weather-dependent thermal-map sessions.
